newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber stable in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber stable in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were generally stable in late trading on Wednesday as the market recovered from the baht turmoil, traders said.

"I think the baht crisis is going to have a small impact on the market, at least in the short term. It may have an impact in the long term, it may have an impact...depending on the baht and Thailand's economic performance in general," said one trader.

"What I can see is that buyers are taking a chance on this situation. We don't know yet what will happen overnight, so let us wait and see. We will have a clearer picture after Tokyo and Singapore's reaction tomorrow," he added.
Traders said a deal was a done at 44.00 U.S. cents/lb fob Palembang. Offer prices were generally stable at 43.75 fob Padang and at 44.50 fob Jambi for October shipment.
Offer prices were quoted at 44.00 fob Surabaya for September shipment and at 43.50 fob Palembang, traders said.
"In general, the market is still weak and the sentiment remains bearish," one trader said.
